blocks.content: For the above problem, suppose we have the following text:
text = A man, a plan, a canal, Panama!

We need to remove non-alphanumeric characters we use the replaceAll() method of the String class. Inside replaceAll(), we pass the regular expression [^a-z0-9] (indicates all the non-alphanumeric characters) and "".
Then, to use the toLowerCase() method to convert all the characters to lowercase. After that we will check if the string is palindrome or not.
After conversion, we check if a string is a string is palindrome or not.
Now, let's see how we can implement this logic in our program for text string.

items: Replace all non-alphanumeric characters in text with an empty string using the replaceAll() method and a regular expression that matches all non-alphanumeric characters.
Convert text to lowercase using the toLowerCase() method.
Get the length of text using the length method and store it in a variable called length.
Loop through the characters of text from the beginning to half of the length of text using a for loop that starts from 0 and ends at length / 2.
For each character in the loop, compare the character at the current index with the character at the opposite index, which is length - i - 1, and if they are not equal, return false.
If the loop completes without returning false, return true.
